summary: Nvidia: Jensen Huang resigned as CEO, president and director on 12 Nov; CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO. The stock is about 30% below its early-October close, a governance selloff rather than a numbers one.
US inflation pace: core CPI is 2.9% year on year but its 3-month annualised pace is 3.75%, so the monthly run-rate is above the yearly number (FRED, October CPI).
US labour: initial jobless claims are running near 195k on a 4-week average, still low (FRED).
